title: bench-hpc ComputeProfile v1
description: Routing-only identity above SiteProfile: compute_class (cpu|gpu) -> named site profile. A Case, the Agent, or the hpc-submit skill selects a class; only this operator-owned document maps the class to a site, and it never carries hosts, partitions, regions, image IDs, credentials, or resource ceilings — those belong to the referenced SiteProfile. Unknown keys fail closed.

profile_id.description: Stable name for this routing identity; bound into every RunLock that runs under it.

routes.description: A missing route is legal here and fatal at routing time: the router fails closed for a class with no route instead of falling back to another site.

site_profile.description: Name of an operator-registered SiteProfile; existence is verified at router construction, not here.
